strings.name: Jackie Chan
strings.summary: Born in Hong Kong, Jackie Chan trained in Peking opera, martial arts and acrobatics, progressing from stunt work to acting, directing and action choreography. Drunken Master and Police Story combined comic timing with difficult stunts, while Rumble in the Bronx and Rush Hour expanded his international audience. He also undertook charitable work and received an honorary Oscar in 2016; his career spans the development of Hong Kong and international action cinema.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones from early training through filming work in October 2026, checked through November 13, 2026; unreleased projects are not described as released works.
strings.influence.rationale: Combining martial arts, comedy and stunt performance, he helped spread kung fu action cinema around the world through Hong Kong and international films.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Training
strings.facts.f2.value: Peking opera, martial arts and acrobatics at the China Drama Academy
strings.highlights.h1.title: Action and comedy
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combined martial arts, comic timing and practical stunts into a distinctive screen style.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Honorary Oscar
strings.highlights.h2.text: Received the Academy’s honorary award in 2016 for his film career, rather than a competitive acting award.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed filming in Kazakhstan
strings.timeline.t1.text: At an Astana press conference, discussed completion of local filming for Armour of God 4; the film was then scheduled for 2027.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Locarno career tribute
strings.timeline.t2.text: Received Locarno’s career award, with the festival also screening his earlier action films.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Received an honorary Oscar
strings.timeline.t3.text: The Academy honored his sustained contributions to performance and action cinema with an honorary award.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Starred in Rush Hour
strings.timeline.t4.text: Co-starred with Chris Tucker in the English-language action comedy, further expanding his Hollywood audience.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Rumble in the Bronx expanded his market
strings.timeline.t5.text: Starred in Rumble in the Bronx; its 1996 US release helped bring him into the American mainstream.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Directed and starred in Police Story
strings.timeline.t6.text: Combined comedy and dangerous stunts in an urban police film that became a major example of his action choreography.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Drunken Master established his comic approach
strings.timeline.t7.text: Films including Drunken Master combined humorous characters with martial arts, establishing his own approach to action comedy.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered drama training
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered the China Drama Academy at seven, undertaking about ten years of Peking opera, martial arts and acrobatic training.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Born in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t9.text: Born in Hong Kong; later progressed from movie stunts and doubling to leading roles and directing.
